data.name: Diptendu
data.gender_notes: Diptendu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Lord of the deep or inner
data.long_meaning: The name Diptendu is derived from the Sanskrit words 'dp' meaning deep and 'tam' meaning inner or enduring. This name is associated with the Hindu god Vishnu, who is often depicted as the preserver of the universe. Diptendu is a name for a boy that signifies a deep and enduring connection to the spiritual world and a strong sense of inner wisdom and understanding.

data.etymology: Diptendu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the deep or inner.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Diptendu total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_sanskrit.name: दिप्तेन्दु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: दिप्तः (Dipta) - Light, ईशानः (Ishana) - God, तेन् (ten) - possessed by, दुः (duh) - difficult, इति (iti) - thus. Thus, Diptendu means God, who is difficult to attain and is the source of divine light.

in_tamil.name: டிப்டெண்டு
in_tamil.long_meaning: டிப் (Tip) - Light, டெண் (Ten) - possessed by, ந் (ndu) - new, உங்கள் (ungal) - our, இது (itu) - this. Thus, Diptendu in Tamil means 'our new light' or 'the light that is within us'.

in_telugu.name: దిప్పెన్టూ
in_telugu.long_meaning: దీప్ (Dipta) - Light, ఎణ్టూ (entu) - possessed by, దేశముదే (desamude) - God. Thus, Diptendu in Telugu means 'God who is the source of light'.

historical_references.reference: The name Diptendu is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Deep' (lamp) and 'Tendu' (to touch). This name was often given to children born during the Diwali festival, as they were believed to be touched by the light of the diyas (oil lamps) and thus blessed with prosperity and success.
historical_references.time_period: Ancient India, around the 5th century BC
historical_references.context: The significance of the name Diptendu is rooted in Hindu mythology and traditions, particularly the celebration of Diwali.

historical_references.reference: In Hindu mythology, Diptendu is also the name of a god associated with light, knowledge, and wisdom. He is often depicted as a celestial being with a lamp in his hand, representing the illumination of knowledge and the power to dispel darkness.
historical_references.time_period: Classical India, around the 1st millennium AD
historical_references.context: The god Diptendu is a significant figure in Hinduism and is revered for his role in bestowing knowledge and wisdom upon his devotees.
